text.tspan: Each bar is that run's score after its final task. Nothing is stood in for and no value
comes from another run. Tasks finished, DUEL (ours) 5/5, CLEAR 5/5, CKA-RL 5/5, CompoNet 5/5.
Every run has finished the sequence, so all bars are measured after the same number of tasks.
